title: Snoot
description: Every check-up, nose to tail. A neighbourhood vet clinic where scrolling walks a stethoscope along Frank the dachshund, with a boopable nose, collar-tag plans and a 3D tennis ball that fetches your booking.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js WebGPU + TSL · Lenis · Tailwind v4

fonts.name: Font / Display
fonts.fallback: Arial Rounded MT Bold, Trebuchet MS, system-ui, sans-serif

fonts.name: Font / Body
fonts.fallback: Avenir Next, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: floating milk pill (logo, nav Check-up / Patients / Plans / Team / Your visit, phone in mono, pink "Book" button). Compresses after 80 px, hides on scroll-down, returns on scroll-up; the active section gets one sliding yolk pill (clip-path); phones get a pink full-screen menu that opens as a clip-path circle from the toggle, with staggered mask-rise links, scroll lock and a focus trap.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: eyebrow "Neighbourhood vet · Easton · open seven days"; h1 "Every check-up, / nose to tail." with a pink squiggle drawn under "nose"; sub-copy; CTAs "Fetch an appointment" (pink, magnetic) and "See the check-up" (milk); three count-up stats (40 min bloods, 1,860 owners rate us 4.9, 2 theatres). Right: a breathing blue blob with a yolk sun, drifting bone/ball/heart props, a tilted patient-chart card ("Frank · 7 y · dachshund · 7.4 kg · ✓ Very good boy"), and **Frank's head** (the same SVG cropped to `viewBox="20 70 520 420"`, body continuing off-frame). His nose is a real `<button aria-label="Boop me: Frank's nose">`: each press squishes the nose, squeezes the eyes, flops the ear, pops a speech bubble ("Boop!", "Hehe.", "Again?", "Snrrk.") and rolls a "1,284 boops today" counter; every fifth boop he sneezes (head jolt + sparks, "Achoo!").

sections.title: Waiting-room ticker
sections.summary: a yolk band tilted −1.6°, marquee of milk patient pills ("Biscuit · 4 · spaniel · ♥ jabs done"), paused off-screen and on hover, with a screen-reader list beside it.

sections.title: The check-up (the mechanic)
sections.summary: blue slab. Heading "Nose to tail, in six stops.", a `01/06` counter, a six-step rail with a sliding yolk pill (links jump to chapters), a chapter card that swaps per chapter, a dark readout pill with a polite live region, Frank on a sliding track, the chest-piece (disc + long ink/pink tube), the ECG and the stamp. Chapters (x, y in Frank's 2600 × 640 viewBox):

sections.title: Who we see
sections.summary: tabs Dogs / Cats / Rabbits / Small & scaly (sliding pink pill, arrow/Home/End keys). Each panel: a 2.5D stage (coloured blob, flat SVG pet in Frank's outline style, a polaroid patient photo) whose layers shift by depth toward the pointer, a headline, copy, a count-up "seen this year" and visit chips. Panels slide in the direction of travel.

sections.title: Snoot plans
sections.summary: pink slab. A monthly/yearly switch (sliding knob, "2 months free") and a 1–4 pets stepper. Three collar tags hanging from rings: Pup & Kit £16, Grown-up £21 (yolk, "Most picked"), Golden Years £29; each extra pet 15 % off; yearly = 10 months. Prices roll on change, tags swing on hover, "What's in it" flips a tag in 3D to its list.

sections.title: The team
sections.summary: four tilt cards (photo, "with Pudding, retired greyhound" sticker, name, role, one line): Dr Adaeze Okafor (clinical director), Dr Ruth Lindgren (surgeon), Dr Kenji Arai (exotics), Sol Medina RVN (head nurse). Tilt + yolk spotlight, lift, photo scale, sibling dimming.

sections.title: Your visit
sections.summary: yolk slab, four steps with wiping photos and numbered pink tags (two doors, treats before needles, the check on their level, out with a plan), a dotted paw trail drawn on scroll, and promise chips.

sections.title: After hours
sections.summary: ink slab, "Something wrong at 3 a.m.? Ring the night vet.", a live open/closed sign computed from the visitor's clock (Mon–Fri 08–20, Sat 09–17, Sun 10–14; "Closing soon" inside 45 minutes; "Doors open 08:00 tomorrow"), a pink emergency-call card with a rolling number, and an hours table.

sections.title: Fetch an appointment
sections.summary: blue slab. Form: pet's name (floating label), species chips, reason select, the next five open days as chips (computed after mount, Sundays skipped), owner name, email or phone. Validation on blur and submit; invalid fields shake and their message slides open; filled fields draw a check. Submit morphs to "Fetching…" with bouncing dots, then the form folds away and a mint dog tag drops in on a wag curve with the summary ("Biscuit · Check-up · Thu 19 Nov") and a pink "Booked" stamp; focus moves to it. No network request. Beside it, **a real-time 3D tennis ball**: `WebGPURenderer` (WebGL2 fallback), `MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial` with sheen, a procedural TSL seam `1 − smoothstep(0.045, 0.07, |n.z − 0.75(n.x² − n.y²)|)` mixing yolk and milk, a fading contact shadow; it bobs, spins on drag with inertia, and on booking success is thrown away and bounces back in. Loaded on idle when near on desktop, on tap on touch screens, never under reduced motion; an SVG poster is the default.
